stdoutContains: 18. Extension DefaultLanguage "Language.Русский" differs from the source configuration "Language.Английский"

18. Language.Русский: ExtendedConfigurationObject (the link to the source object) is zero — it matches nothing, so the platform loads the extension but does not apply it. Set it to the uuid attribute of the language in the source configuration (Languages/Русский.xml)
